environment.description: Same Terraform provider running in namespace 'ci-runners' on EKS 1.28. Cluster has Cilium CNI with a CiliumNetworkPolicy applied at namespace level. The policy spec uses a combination of entity-based egress rules: it allows DNS (kube-dns on port 53), allows egress to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 (internal VPC), and allows egress to 0.0.0.0/0 EXCEPT link-local range. Specifically, the policy includes an egressDeny rule matching toEndpoints with reserved:world and toCIDR 169.254.0.0/16. Note: this is NOT a standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy — it's a CiliumNetworkPolicy with L3/L4 filtering only (no L7 inspection). The deny rule is evaluated before allow rules per Cilium's policy precedence model. Additionally, the cluster has IMDSv2 enforced at the node level with HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1, but since Cilium's deny rule operates at L3 before packets reach the node's iptables IMDS rules, the network deny is the primary control.
